text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear stance in opening and repeated conclusion","quality":"positioning","description":"It states a definite argument against driverless cars and stays consistently on that side throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"“will ultimately cause more crashes” and later “death and economic issues”","quality":"claim development","description":"It develops a central claim with more than one reason, giving the argument a clearer line of support."},{"evidence":"questions about glitches, not paying attention, and fatal consequences","quality":"elaboration","description":"It explains its concerns with more extended reasoning instead of just naming objections."},{"evidence":"paragraphs that begin with a general point and then build on it","quality":"organization","description":"Its ideas are arranged more coherently, with a clearer introduction, body, and closing."},{"evidence":"“It’s physically impossible” and “could easily get in a car accident”","quality":"assertive tone","description":"It sounds more confident and controlled in its criticism, making the argument feel firmer."}]}
